name: odoo-development
description: odoo development plugin for cursor with focused skills, commands, rules, hooks, and mcp-code-first workflows for odoo 18 and 19 community and enterprise.

ODOO_VERSION.description: Target Odoo version (14-19). Auto-detected from nearest __manifest__.py or defaults to 18.

ODOO_MCP_CODE_URL.description: Primary odoo-codemode MCP endpoint (compact multi-step research). Active by default in mcp.json.

ODOO_MCP_URL.description: Optional full odoo-knowledge MCP endpoint. Disabled by default; see mcp.knowledge.disabled.json.example.
